name: shushah
method: Sentinel-2 satellite-derived bathymetry, Stumpf log-ratio, uncalibrated
toCalibrate: ICESat-2 ATL24 crosses this reef; two granules would pin the scale
colourIs: bottom reflectance with the water column taken back out, in the bands that survived it — structure, not true colour. Red is gone in four metres, so a reef in fifteen has no red left to recover and this cannot say what colour the coral is.

heightfield.format: little-endian float32, row major, south to north then west to east
